name: @guygrigsby/pi-image-paste
description: Paste images from the Mac clipboard into pi running on a remote machine over ssh. A launchd socket service on the Mac serves the clipboard image; an ssh RemoteForward carries it; the extension fetches it on ctrl+v and attaches it like a native paste.
